description:
SBI code search

Searches through all SBI codes and titles using a free-text query.
Returns up to 25 matches, ordered by level (broad → specific) and code.

Source: [CBS Standaard Bedrijfsindeling 2025](https://www.cbs.nl/sbi)

Cost: 0.1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: cbs.sbi.search
